text: {"assertions":["A missed run bug in the scheduler affected only clients still using the v1 SDK.","The root cause was an error being swallowed by a bare except clause in worker/scheduler/cron.py.","The bug could be reproduced by advancing a fake clock across the schedule.","The bug was signaled by a slot with no execution record.","Fixing the bug recovered 54 GB of blob storage.","The fix narrowed the exception handler to allow failures to propagate properly.","The fix was implemented in PR #4554 on branch fix/missed-run-1.","The bug occurred in the same section of worker/scheduler/cron.py as a previous missed run issue."]}
